facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office, led by Acting National Data Protection Director Baker Birikujja, referred a registration offence for prosecution.
The Monitor reports a conviction under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97, for offences committed between 2023 and 2025.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97

facts.fact: A Makindye court convicted Ronald Mugulusi of Nano Loans Microfinance, operator of the Quickloan app, for failing to register with the PDPO and fined him Shs300,000, after a guilty plea on 10 July 2025.
